description: This file contains a suite of shell test scripts designed to verify the behavior of Git commands related to object diffing, partial clone handling, rename detection, and fetch optimization. It sets up repository scenarios, performs Git operations, and checks the internal protocol trace to ensure correct behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing a shell command sequence.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository at a specified location.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in a specified repository.

methods.name: git clone
methods.description: Clones a repository with specified options.

methods.name: git rm
methods.description: Removes files from the index and working tree.

methods.name: git hash-object
methods.description: Computes the object ID for given content.

methods.name: git diff
methods.description: Shows changes between commits, working tree, etc.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specific path does not exist.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines in a file.
